=== EMAIL to primary@example.com
Subject: Permit updated: Visitor now has no rego
Provenance: You received this at primary@example.com because this address manages, or shares access to, a p.stonn account that schedules a visitor parking permit. p.stonn is a free, unofficial scheduler for City of Stonnington visitor parking permits.

Your Visitor now has no rego on it, for a one-off booking made by sam@example.com that clears the permit. Nothing is covered on that permit until that booking ends.

Nothing to do — this is just your confirmation it went through.

We have also told sam@example.com (by email).

https://p.stonn.org
